column3: The renewals job in cmd/billing/jobs.go issues invoices for due subscriptions and the notify outbox drains them, but credit.ApplyCreditToInvoice runs only from internal/register/checkout.go and payments.Agreements.ChargeDue is scheduled nowhere, so the cron's apply-credits and charge-agreements halves are absent.

internal/lifecycle/orders.go CancelUnpaidOrders reads cronjob.order_cancel_days, voids the open invoices, restores stock and cancels the pending subscription, registered through lifecycle.Jobs in cmd/billing/jobs.go with its own kill switch.

internal/service/upgrades.go CancelStaleUpgrades voids unpaid upgrade invoices after StaleUpgradeAfter and cancels the row, but its own doc comment still says 'wire it into cmd/billing/jobs.go' and no jobSpec calls it.

internal/dunning Engine.Advance plus suspendEligible and resumeCleared in cmd/billing/jobs.go escalate overdue invoices, suspend exhausted services and resume paid ones, with BILLING_DISABLE_SUSPENSION as the brake.

internal/lifecycle/terminate.go TerminateSuspended reads cronjob.terminate_days, refuses a service under an active hold or with nothing owed, and enqueues a terminate operation through the provisioning queue instead of writing services.status.
tickets.CloseStale is the ticket-autoclose job in cmd/billing/jobs.go, running every six hours against the tickets.autoclose_days setting.
internal/retention sweeps a closed allow-list of tables including notification_deliveries against per-table policies as the six-hour retention job.

cron_runs and its readers at GET /api/v1/staff/cron and GET /api/v1/staff/cron/heartbeat exist in internal/httpapi/cron.go, but cmd/billing/worker.go calls neither httpapi.RecordRun nor httpapi.Beat, so the history and heartbeat are written only by tests.

cronjob.order_cancel_days, cronjob.terminate_days and tickets.autoclose_days are declared in internal/settings/settings.go and rendered by web/src/views/system-settings.ts, but the dunning ladder still runs the hard-coded dunning.DefaultPolicy() constants from cmd/billing/jobs.go.

internal/importer/profile.go whmcsProfile reads only clients, invoices, invoice_items, services and transactions, so tickets, products, orders, cancellations, admins and currencies from a WHMCS dump are not imported.
source=paymenter selects paymenterProfile in internal/importer/profile.go behind POST /api/v1/staff/imports, with a dry run by default, idempotency on the legacy id and per-row rejection codes.

internal/updates/check.go performs the cached check and POST /api/v1/staff/updates/approval records the approved target version, while applying it stays a deploy step named in the response's apply.steps - a deliberate deployment-shape divergence rather than a missing button.

internal/updates/telemetry.go builds an opt-in payload of fixed integer counts with a preview and a telemetry_sends history, but delivery only happens when an operator calls POST /api/v1/staff/updates/telemetry/send, as no daily job exists.

internal/marketplace installs an indexed extension only after a SHA-256 match and serves the verified artifact, but there is no upload of a local extension and no in-place update - a same-version reinstall with different bytes is refused as marketplace_already_installed.

error_logs and http_logs have keyset viewers in internal/httpapi/logs.go and 'billing admin logs tail', but nothing in the middleware or worker calls WriteError/WriteHTTP, so both tables stay empty, and internal/settings/settings.go declares no debug-mode setting.

worker_heartbeat, Beat and the stale-derivation reader live in internal/httpapi/cron.go, but cmd/billing/worker.go never calls httpapi.Beat, so the row that would prove the scheduler is alive is only written by operator_test.go.

cmd/billing/main.go exposes serve, worker, migrate, doctor, admin and version and cmd/billing/admin.go adds create-user, create-customer, issue-invoice, purge-test-data, setting set and logs tail, but there is no password-reset subcommand.

/healthz is liveness with no database touch and /readyz pings the pool and counts pending migrations (internal/httpapi/server.go), backed by 'billing doctor' in cmd/billing/main.go which also starts each configured extension.
/metrics is registered in internal/httpapi/routes_core.go as a staff-only route and exposes Prometheus counters and uptime.
gateway_events is the durable inbox with processed_at and last_error, and GET /api/v1/staff/webhooks in internal/httpapi/staff_read.go backs the reprocessing screen in web/src/views/webhooks.ts.

internal/httpapi/announcements.go gives staff CRUD and a public feed with server-derived state gated on announcements.enabled, with a nav entry in web/src/ui/layout.ts and display on the storefront and dashboard through web/src/ui/announcement-feed.ts.

internal/growth/affiliates.go has the model, exact-rational rate, suspend/reinstate/delete, payouts and web/src/views/affiliates.ts, but growth.AttributeSignup has no call site - handleRegister in internal/httpapi/register.go accepts no referral code and ReferralCodeFromRequest is never used - so no referral row is ever created.

growth.RecordSettledInvoiceCommission is called inside the settlement transaction in internal/fulfilment/applier.go and covers the first-order commission plus the recurring one from internal/growth/recurring.go, bounded by affiliates.recurring_cycles.
internal/growth/discord.go posts rich embeds to the settings-held webhook URL for a closed set of selectable events (KnownEvents), best-effort after commit and never inside the transaction.

internal/extproto/hooks.go and internal/httpapi/extension_hooks.go deliver nav items, permission-checked service actions and broker events to a v2 extension, but no web/src view consumes /api/v1/extensions/hooks and there are no admin-resource, page or checkout-config hooks.

locales and message_catalog are rows with coverage, a default enforced by partial unique index and an enabled set (internal/i18n, migration 0037_i18n.sql), but i18n.Store.SetUserLocale has no HTTP route and web/src/lib/i18n.ts persists the choice in localStorage only, so a per-user preference is never written.

languageSwitcher in web/src/lib/i18n.ts renders in web/src/ui/layout.ts and web/src/views/storefront.ts and is absent when one locale is enabled, and sign-in, register, forgot-password, storefront and portal all render through tx().

client-side field validation goes through catalogue keys such as register.error.name_required in web/src/views/register.ts, but the problem details written by writeProblem in internal/httpapi are English strings with no catalogue keys.

web/src/styles/tokens.css is one token vocabulary with light and dark themes, extended by the per-mode accent overlay in web/src/lib/brand.ts, but there are no theme packages, presets or per-scope overrides (docs/branding.md section 5).

No theme marketplace by design: web/web.go serves style-src 'self' and img-src 'self' data:, so a listing that shipped arbitrary CSS or JS could not run without loosening the CSP (docs/branding.md section 5).

notification templates are editable rows in internal/notify/templates.go with a staff editor, but they are text/plain with {{company_name}} substitution only - no branded header, footer or CSS, and HTML mail is refused on purpose.

internal/httpapi/branding.go and web/src/views/branding.ts give a per-tenant name, one uploaded PNG or JPEG logo and a per-mode accent that reach the panel chrome and the invoice PDF, but there is no dark-mode logo, favicon or social card (docs/branding.md section 5) and SMTP sender settings live separately in internal/settings/settings.go.
No Gravatar: avatars are local initials from avatar() in web/src/ui/kit.ts, and the img-src 'self' data: CSP in web/web.go would refuse a gravatar.com origin.
